from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
import zipfile, io, json, hashlib, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
base=Path.home()/'workspace/release_lab'
out=base/'out'/'client'
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
# Normalize GIMP exports to opaque RGB PNGs (retain their exact displayed pixel values).
for name in ('client_banner.png','client_thumbnail.png'):
    p=out/name
    im=Image.open(p).convert('RGB')
    im.save(p, format='PNG', optimize=True)
# Rebuild a standards-compliant OpenRaster working source from the editable layers in the provided ORA.
with zipfile.ZipFile(base/'assets'/'client_source.ora','r') as src:
    background=Image.open(io.BytesIO(src.read('data/background.png'))).convert('RGB')
    mark=Image.open(io.BytesIO(src.read('data/brand_mark.png'))).convert('RGB')
# Compose the visible top brand layer at its original layer offset, correcting the stale merged preview.
composite=background.copy()
composite.paste(mark,(40,40))
merged=io.BytesIO(); composite.save(merged,format='PNG')
thumb=composite.copy(); thumb.thumbnail((256,256),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
thumb_io=io.BytesIO(); thumb.save(thumb_io,format='PNG')
stack=b'''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n<image version="0.0.1" w="800" h="450" name="Client Launch Artwork"><stack><layer name="Brand mark" src="data/brand_mark.png" x="40" y="40" opacity="1.0" visibility="visible" composite-op="svg:src-over"/><layer name="Background" src="data/background.png" x="0" y="0" opacity="1.0" visibility="visible" composite-op="svg:src-over"/></stack></image>\n'''
ora=out/'client_source.ora'
with zipfile.ZipFile(ora,'w') as z:
    z.writestr('mimetype','image/openraster',compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_STORED)
    z.writestr('stack.xml',stack,compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
    z.writestr('data/brand_mark.png', (base/'assets'/'brand_mark.png').read_bytes(), compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
    # Keep the source background layer from the supplied ORA, not the flat preview.
    with zipfile.ZipFile(base/'assets'/'client_source.ora','r') as src:
        background_bytes=src.read('data/background.png')
    z.writestr('data/background.png',background_bytes,compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
    z.writestr('mergedimage.png',merged.getvalue(),compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
    z.writestr(' Thumbnails/thumbnail.png',thumb_io.getvalue(),compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
# Remove accidental leading-space archive member and add the optional thumbnail at the standard path.
with zipfile.ZipFile(ora,'r') as z:
    members={n:z.read(n) for n in z.namelist() if not n.startswith(' ')}
# Rewrite with mimetype first as required by OpenRaster readers.
with zipfile.ZipFile(ora,'w') as z:
    z.writestr('mimetype',members['mimetype'],compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_STORED)
    for n in ('stack.xml','data/brand_mark.png','data/background.png','mergedimage.png'):
        z.writestr(n,members[n],compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
    z.writestr('Thumbnails/thumbnail.png',thumb_io.getvalue(),compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
# Ensure files are RGB images with expected dimensions.
checks=[('out/client/client_banner.png',640,360),('out/client/client_thumbnail.png',320,180),('out/client/client_source.ora',800,450)]
artifacts=[]
for rel,w,h in checks:
    p=base/rel
    if rel.endswith('.ora'):
        with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
            im=Image.open(io.BytesIO(z.read('mergedimage.png')))
            assert im.size==(w,h)
    else:
        im=Image.open(p)
        assert im.mode=='RGB' and im.size==(w,h),(rel,im.mode,im.size)
    artifacts.append({'path':rel,'size_bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'width':w,'height':h})
release={'source_ids':['C-ALPHA','C-THUMB'],'artifacts':artifacts}
(out/'client_release.json').write_text(json.dumps(release,indent=2)+'\n')
# Change only the client section; preserve every other manifest section.
manifest_path=base/'release_manifest.json'

receipt=json.loads((base/'out/client/qa_receipt.json').read_text())
assert receipt['state']=='FINAL' and receipt['issues']==[]
assert release['source_ids']==['C-ALPHA','C-THUMB']
for a in release['artifacts']:
    p=base/a['path']
    h=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert h==a['sha256']==manifest['client']['artifacts'][a['path']], (a['path'],h,a['sha256'],manifest['client']['artifacts'].get(a['path']))
    assert p.stat().st_size==a['size_bytes']
    if p.suffix=='.png':
        im=Image.open(p)
        assert im.mode=='RGB' and im.size==(a['width'],a['height'])
    print(a['path'],a['size_bytes'],h)
ora=base/'out/client/client_source.ora'
with zipfile.ZipFile(ora) as z:
    assert z.namelist()[0]=='mimetype' and z.read('mimetype')==b'image/openraster'
    im=Image.open(io.BytesIO(z.read('mergedimage.png')))
    assert im.size==(800,450)
    print('ORA layers:',[n for n in z.namelist() if n.startswith('data/')], 'merged:',im.size,im.mode)
assert manifest['server']['artifacts']=={
'out/server/server_package.zip':'f94cb4ae5c327c875d3a44af585e2ad2a92485159e8118020938bb9e2919861f',
'out/server/server_release.json':'fe2a4a6a4ad0035d7151cd27e5bfd985c6987e4d059fdd94159f6267642e4983',
'out/server/checksums.sha256':'160c2d06b2668ccb0e29f134eb3c684bce5fa870aabdd8ec8ae0e65d4cf3574f'}
print('QA receipt:',receipt)
print('manifest QA state:',manifest.get('qa_state'))
print('OK')
